checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead fee, with no second basic facilities or staff fee.
D-embalming is printed on page 1 and the Embalming price of $795 is also on page 1.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is printed on page 2 and the direct cremation range $1,595 to $1,945 is also on page 2.
Direct cremation is offered with a purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists what is included and no separate crematory cash advance charge is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or description.
The list contains only required single-price items like forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial, and no optional combination package.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires purchase of any item, apart from the prescribed disclosure wording.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No additional wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the printed disclosures use the prescribed wording.
